newsitem.title: USA: Panenergy raises earning growth target.
newsitem.headline: Panenergy raises earning growth target.

text.p: PanEnergy Corp on Thursday said that positive earning results have inspired the company to lift its earnings growth target to 15 percent fpr the year.

"Based on year-to-date performance, the company is raising its previously announced 10 percent earnings growth target to 15 percent for the year," Paul Anderson, president and chief executive officer of Panenergy said in a statement.

This morning, the energy services firm reported third-quarter net income increased 17 percent to $86.1 million, compared with $73.6 million last year. Earnings per share increased to $0.57, compared with $0.49 per share for the same period last year.
"PanEnergy had an excellent third quarter during which the company continued to gain momentum," he added.
